entities.summary: Uini Atonio is a former professional rugby union player who played as a prop. He played most of his career for Top 14 club La Rochelle. Born in New Zealand, he represented France at international level after qualifying on residency grounds. He retired at the age of 35 due to a heart attack in January 2026.
